question: Should OpenClaw persist an immutable root and dedicated chain identifier on each spawned session, or derive lineage from direct parent links and reuse an existing tracing concept?
rationale: Both approaches can support traversal, but they create different persistence, upgrade, protocol, and diagnostic semantics that cannot be safely selected from implementation details alone.

options.title: Persist dedicated lineage
options.body: Store immutable rootSessionKey and a session-chain identifier separate from diagnostic trace context, with optional fields for existing sessions.

options.title: Derive from parent links
options.body: Keep only direct parent and depth metadata, deriving roots and chains during traversal without introducing another persisted identifier.

options.title: Reuse diagnostic tracing
options.body: Bridge session lineage to an existing trace identifier, accepting tighter coupling between durable orchestration identity and transient observability.

recommendation.title: Persist dedicated lineage
recommendation.body: Store immutable rootSessionKey and a session-chain identifier separate from diagnostic trace context, with optional fields for existing sessions.
